logline: An obituary writer returns to her childhood lake town for a funeral and finds herself face to face with the ex-boyfriend she left behind - and the summer that shaped them both.

renewal.note: Single-season limited series. All 8 episodes released on Amazon Prime Video on 10 June 2026. Based on Carley Fortune's novel Every Summer After.

seasons.review_body: Every Year After adapts Carley Fortune's bestselling novel with steady craftsmanship but inconsistent momentum. At 70 percent on Rotten Tomatoes from 23 critics and a Metacritic score of 56 from 10 reviewers, the series earned mixed notices. Critics praised the British Columbia lakeside atmosphere and the leads' chemistry, but flagged the pacing as sluggish before the midpoint and the resolution as telegraphed well in advance. The eight-episode run benefits from a coherent grief-and-rekindled-love premise and a specific sense of place, yet struggles to translate the novel's introspective rhythm into propulsive television. Serviceable for fans of slow-burn romance; the book likely remains the sharper artifact.
